@@ -1,0 +1,86 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Cuts an 8-view character sheet on a flat chroma backdrop (purple, green...)
+- two rows of four figures, no labels - into transparent pictures for a
+SheetPuppet, plus a head-and-shoulders portrait.
+
+    python3 -I tools/cut_chroma_sheet.py <sheet.png> <out_dir> <id> [--height 280]
+        [--order sw,s,se,e,ne,n,nw,w] [--portrait s]
+
+Writes <out_dir>/<id>_idle_<dir>.png (each figure cropped to itself, scaled
+to --height px tall, its feet at the bottom) and <out_dir>/<id>_portrait.png
+(the top of the --portrait view, square). --order names the eight figures
+left to right, top row first (default: one turn of the character starting
+front-left - sw s se e / ne n nw w). The backdrop is the sheet's border
+colour; pixels near it become transparent, edges are softened and the
+backdrop's tint is taken out of them (despill).
+"""
+import sys, argparse
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
+
+ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+ap.add_argument("sheet"); ap.add_argument("out"); ap.add_argument("id")
+ap.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=280)
+ap.add_argument("--order", default="sw,s,se,e,ne,n,nw,w")
+ap.add_argument("--portrait", default="s")
+a = ap.parse_args()
+order = a.order.split(",")
+assert len(order) == 8
+
+src = Image.open(a.sheet).convert("RGB")
+im = np.asarray(src).astype(float)
+H, W = im.shape[:2]
+border = np.concatenate([im[:6].reshape(-1, 3), im[-6:].reshape(-1, 3), im[:, :6].reshape(-1, 3), im[:, -6:].reshape(-1, 3)])
+BG = np.median(border, axis=0)
+dist = np.sqrt(((im - BG) ** 2).sum(2))
+# Opacity: 0 near the backdrop, 1 well away from it, a ramp between (soft edges).
+alpha = np.clip((dist - 60.0) / 70.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+# Keep only real figures: drop specks.
+solid = Image.fromarray((alpha > 0.5).astype(np.uint8) * 255).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(3)).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(5))
+solid = np.asarray(solid) > 0
+alpha = alpha * solid
+# Despill: take the backdrop's tint out of edge pixels (purple: too much red+blue vs green).
+rgb = im.copy()
+bg_dir = BG / max(np.linalg.norm(BG), 1)
+grey = rgb.mean(2, keepdims=True)
+edge = (1.0 - alpha)[..., None]
+rgb = rgb * (1 - edge * 0.85) + grey * (edge * 0.85)
+# Also cap the backdrop's dominant channels at the others' level across the figure (spill on cloth).
+dom = np.argsort(BG)[::-1][:2]
+other = [c for c in range(3) if c not in dom][0]
+for c in dom:
+    rgb[..., c] = np.minimum(rgb[..., c], np.maximum(rgb[..., other] * 1.35 + 18, rgb[..., c] * (1 - 0.6 * edge[..., 0])))
+
+# The rows split at the emptiest line around the middle (figures may reach past it).
+prof = (alpha > 0.3).sum(1)
+mid = int(H * 0.4) + int(np.argmin(prof[int(H * 0.4):int(H * 0.6)]))
+rows = [(0, mid), (mid, H)]
+done = {}
+for r, (y0, y1) in enumerate(rows):
+    for k in range(4):
+        x0, x1 = W * k // 4, W * (k + 1) // 4
+        al = alpha[y0:y1, x0:x1]
+        ys, xs = np.nonzero(al > 0.3)
+        if len(ys) == 0:
+            sys.exit("no figure in cell %d,%d" % (r, k))
+        by0, by1, bx0, bx1 = ys.min(), ys.max() + 1, xs.min(), xs.max() + 1
+        if bx0 == 0 or bx1 == x1 - x0 or by0 == 0 or by1 == y1 - y0:
+            print("TOUCHES cell", r, k)
+        cut = np.dstack([rgb[y0:y1, x0:x1], al * 255])[by0:by1, bx0:bx1]
+        pic = Image.fromarray(np.clip(cut, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), "RGBA")
+        s = a.height / pic.height
+        pic = pic.resize((max(1, round(pic.width * s)), a.height), Image.LANCZOS)
+        d = order[r * 4 + k]
+        pic.save("%s/%s_idle_%s.png" % (a.out, a.id, d))
+        done[d] = pic
+        print(d, pic.size)
+# Portrait: the top of the chosen view (head and shoulders), square, on transparent.
+p = done[a.portrait]
+w = p.width
+top = p.crop((0, 0, w, int(w * 1.0)))

+sq = Image.new("RGBA", (side, side), (0, 0, 0, 0))
+sq.paste(top, ((side - top.width) // 2, 0))
+sq = sq.resize((256, 256), Image.LANCZOS)
+sq.save("%s/%s_portrait.png" % (a.out, a.id))
+print("portrait", sq.size)

@@ -1,0 +1,70 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Cuts an 8-view prop sheet (two rows of four) whose backdrop is a smooth
+gradient (glows, vignettes - not a flat colour) into transparent pictures.
+
+    python3 -I tools/cut_soft_sheet.py <sheet.png> <out_dir> <prefix> --views a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h
+        [--keep sw,se,...] [--height 200] [--smooth 7.0]
+
+The backdrop is told apart by being smooth: pixels whose local contrast is
+low and that connect to the cell's border through other smooth pixels are
+backdrop; the rest is the object (smooth patches it encloses - a cushion -
+stay). Edges are softened by a pixel. --views names the eight figures left to
+right, top row first; --keep writes only those; each picture is cropped to
+the object and scaled to --height px tall: <out_dir>/<prefix>_<view>.png.
+"""
+import argparse
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
+
+ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+ap.add_argument("sheet"); ap.add_argument("out"); ap.add_argument("prefix")
+ap.add_argument("--views", required=True)
+ap.add_argument("--keep", default="")
+ap.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=200)
+ap.add_argument("--smooth", type=float, default=7.0)
+a = ap.parse_args()
+views = a.views.split(",")
+keep = set(a.keep.split(",")) if a.keep else set(views)
+src = Image.open(a.sheet).convert("RGB")
+W, H = src.size
+blur = np.asarray(src.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(1.5))).astype(float)
+gx = np.abs(np.diff(blur, axis=1, prepend=blur[:, :1])).sum(2)
+gy = np.abs(np.diff(blur, axis=0, prepend=blur[:1])).sum(2)
+grad = np.maximum(gx, gy)
+smooth = np.asarray(Image.fromarray((grad < a.smooth).astype(np.uint8) * 255).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(3))) > 0
+rgb = np.asarray(src)
+for r in range(2):
+    for k in range(4):
+        name = views[r * 4 + k]
+        if name not in keep:
+            continue
+        x0, x1, y0, y1 = W * k // 4, W * (k + 1) // 4, H * r // 2, H * (r + 1) // 2
+        sm = smooth[y0:y1, x0:x1]
+        bg = np.zeros_like(sm)
+        bg[0, :] = sm[0, :]; bg[-1, :] = sm[-1, :]; bg[:, 0] = sm[:, 0]; bg[:, -1] = sm[:, -1]
+        while True:   # grow the backdrop through smooth pixels
+            g = bg.copy()
+            g[1:] |= bg[:-1]; g[:-1] |= bg[1:]; g[:, 1:] |= bg[:, :-1]; g[:, :-1] |= bg[:, 1:]
+            g &= sm
+            if (g == bg).all():
+                break
+            bg = g
+        obj = ~bg
+        # Keep the biggest blob (drop specks), fill it out by a pixel back (the smoothness test ate its rim).
+        m = Image.fromarray(obj.astype(np.uint8) * 255).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(3)).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(5))
+        alpha = np.asarray(m.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(0.8))).astype(float) / 255.0
+        alpha = np.clip((alpha - 0.15) / 0.7, 0, 1) * obj.astype(float) ** 0 
+        ys, xs = np.nonzero(alpha > 0.5)
+        # Despill: edge pixels tinted by the backdrop (here a purple floor glow:
+        # more blue than red) fade out; inside the object nothing changes.
+        cell = rgb[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(float)
+        near_edge = np.asarray(Image.fromarray((alpha < 0.98).astype(np.uint8) * 255).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(5))) > 0
+        tinted = (cell[..., 2] > cell[..., 0] * 0.95) & (cell[..., 2] > 40)
+        alpha = np.where(near_edge & tinted, alpha * 0.15, alpha)
+        cut = np.dstack([rgb[y0:y1, x0:x1], (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)])
+        cut = cut[ys.min():ys.max() + 1, xs.min():xs.max() + 1]
+        pic = Image.fromarray(cut, "RGBA")
+        s = a.height / pic.height
+        pic = pic.resize((max(1, round(pic.width * s)), a.height), Image.LANCZOS)
+        pic.save("%s/%s_%s.png" % (a.out, a.prefix, name))
+        print(name, pic.size, "touches" if xs.min() == 0 or xs.max() == x1 - x0 - 1 or ys.min() == 0 or ys.max() == y1 - y0 - 1 else "")

@@ -1,0 +1,516 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""The game's music: three ambient electronic tracks, composed and synthesised
+from scratch (numpy only), each a seamless 2-minute loop.
+
+  menu     "Atrapos"        72 BPM, D minor  - lush, hopeful: pads, a delayed arpeggio, bells
+  space    "Deep Drift"     60 BPM, C minor  - vast and dark: drones, slow chords, twinkles,
+                                               sonar pings, noise swells
+  surface  "Minoan Shores"  96 BPM, A minor / E Phrygian dominant - warm, ancient: a lyre-like
+                                               arpeggio, frame drum and shaker, a breathy flute,
+                                               the sea
+
+  python3 tools/music_gen.py [track ...]   -> music/<track>.ogg (stereo, 44.1 kHz, Vorbis q4)
+                                              external/music/<track>.png (spectrogram + level)
+                                              external/music/analysis.md
+
+How a track is made: notes (bar, beat, MIDI note, length in beats) are
+rendered by simple instruments - an additive saw pad (a few detuned voices),
+an FM bell, an additive pluck (higher harmonics dying faster), a sub bass, a
+breathy flute, a frame drum, a shaker, noise textures - onto dry and reverb
+send buses; the pads go through a slowly sweeping low-pass; a stereo
+convolution reverb (decaying noise) and a ping-pong delay; then a gentle
+compressor, the level set to about -17 dBFS RMS and a soft limit at -1 dBFS.
+Seamless: everything is rendered with 12 s of tail past the loop's end and the
+tail is added back onto the start, so reverb and long notes ring across the
+loop point; each track also starts and ends in the same musical state. Every
+random choice is seeded - the same files every run.
+"""
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import wave
+
+import numpy as np
+
+SR = 44100
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "music")
+REPORT = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "music")
+LOOP = 120.0
+TAIL = 12.0
+
+
+def mtof(m):
+    return 440.0 * 2 ** ((np.asarray(m, float) - 69) / 12)
+
+
+NOTE = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"])}
+NOTE.update({"Db": 1, "Eb": 3, "Gb": 6, "Ab": 8, "Bb": 10})
+
+
+def n(name):
+    """'D3' -> MIDI 50."""
+    return NOTE[name[:-1]] + 12 * (int(name[-1]) + 1)
+
+
+# --- the mix ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+class Mix:
+    def __init__(self, bpm, seed):
+        self.bpm = bpm
+        self.beat = 60.0 / bpm
+        self.N = int((LOOP + TAIL) * SR)
+        self.dry = np.zeros((2, self.N))
+        self.send = np.zeros((2, self.N))
+        self.pad = np.zeros((2, self.N))       # (the pads' own bus: a sweeping low-pass)
+        self.delay = np.zeros((2, self.N))     # (into the ping-pong delay)
+        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+
+    def at(self, bar, beat=0.0):
+        return (bar * 4 + beat) * self.beat
+
+    def add(self, x, t0, pan=0.0, rev=0.3, bus="dry", gain=1.0, delay=0.0):
+        i = int(t0 * SR)
+        if i >= self.N or len(x) == 0:
+            return
+        x = x[: self.N - i] * gain
+        l, r = np.cos((pan + 1) * np.pi / 4), np.sin((pan + 1) * np.pi / 4)
+        target = self.pad if bus == "pad" else self.dry
+        target[0, i:i + len(x)] += x * l
+        target[1, i:i + len(x)] += x * r
+        if rev:
+            self.send[0, i:i + len(x)] += x * l * rev
+            self.send[1, i:i + len(x)] += x * r * rev
+        if delay:
+            self.delay[0, i:i + len(x)] += x * l * delay
+            self.delay[1, i:i + len(x)] += x * r * delay
+
+
+def env(n_s, a, r, total):
+    """Linear-ish attack a, hold, release r (s) over total s - a smooth envelope."""
+    t = np.arange(int(total * SR)) / SR
+    e = np.minimum(1, t / max(a, 1e-3))
+    e = e * np.clip((total - t) / max(r, 1e-3), 0, 1)
+    return e ** 1.5
+
+
+# --- instruments -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def pad_note(m, dur, rng, voices=5, detune=0.12, bright=1.0, a=2.0, r=2.5, shape="saw"):
+    """A soft pad: detuned additive saws (or triangles), slow attack and release."""
+    total = dur + r
+    t = np.arange(int(total * SR)) / SR
+    f0 = float(mtof(m))
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    kmax = max(1, int(min(3500 * bright, 8000) / f0))   # (the pads are low-passed anyway)
+    for v in range(voices):
+        f = f0 * 2 ** (rng.uniform(-detune, detune) / 12)
+        ph = rng.uniform(0, 2 * np.pi)
+        drift = 1 + 0.0015 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(0.1, 0.3) * t + rng.uniform(0, 6))
+        base = 2 * np.pi * f * np.cumsum(drift) / SR + ph
+        for k in range(1, kmax + 1):
+            if shape == "tri":
+                if k % 2 == 0:
+                    continue
+                amp = 1 / k ** 2
+            else:
+                amp = 1 / k
+            out += np.sin(k * base) * amp
+    return out / voices * env(None, a, r, total) * 0.3
+
+
+def bell(m, rng, decay=3.0, ratio=3.5, index=2.5):
+    """An FM bell: a sine modulated at a non-integer ratio, the brightness dying away."""
+    total = decay * 2.2
+    t = np.arange(int(total * SR)) / SR
+    f = float(mtof(m))
+    idx = index * np.exp(-t / (decay * 0.35))
+    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + idx * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * ratio * t))
+    x += 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * 2.01 * t) * np.exp(-t / (decay * 0.5))
+    return x * np.exp(-t / decay) * np.minimum(1, t / 0.004) * 0.35
+
+
+def pluck(m, rng, decay=1.2, bright=1.0, inharm=0.0004):
+    """A plucked string (lyre / harp): harmonics, the higher ones dying faster."""
+    total = decay * 3
+    t = np.arange(int(total * SR)) / SR
+    f = float(mtof(m))
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    kmax = max(1, int(9000 * bright / f))
+    for k in range(1, min(kmax, 24) + 1):
+        fk = f * k * np.sqrt(1 + inharm * k * k)
+        out += np.sin(2 * np.pi * fk * t + rng.uniform(0, 6)) * (1 / k ** 1.1) * np.exp(-t * (1 + 0.55 * (k - 1)) / decay)
+    return out * np.minimum(1, t / 0.002) * 0.3
+
+
+def sub(m, dur, a=0.3, r=0.8):
+    total = dur + r
+    t = np.arange(int(total * SR)) / SR
+    f = float(mtof(m))
+    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) + 0.18 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f * t)
+    return x * env(None, a, r, total) * 0.5
+
+
+def flute(m, dur, rng, vib=5.2):
+    total = dur + 0.25
+    t = np.arange(int(total * SR)) / SR
+    f = float(mtof(m))
+    vibd = 0.006 * np.clip((t - 0.35) / 0.5, 0, 1)
+    ph = 2 * np.pi * f * np.cumsum(1 + vibd * np.sin(2 * np.pi * vib * t)) / SR
+    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.22 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.08 * np.sin(3 * ph)
+    breath = band_noise(len(t), rng, f * 0.8, f * 4) * 0.18
+    e = env(None, 0.12, 0.25, total)
+    return (x + breath) * e * 0.32
+
+
+def band_noise(n_, rng, lo, hi):
+    x = rng.standard_normal(n_)
+    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
+    fr = np.fft.rfftfreq(n_, 1 / SR)
+    g = (1 / (1 + (lo / np.maximum(fr, 1)) ** 4)) * (1 / (1 + (fr / hi) ** 4))
+    y = np.fft.irfft(X * g, n_)
+    return y / (np.std(y) + 1e-9)
+
+
+def drum(kind, rng):
+    """Frame drum: 'dum' (deep, the middle of the skin) and 'tek' (the rim)."""
+    if kind == "dum":
+        t = np.arange(int(0.6 * SR)) / SR
+        f = 70 + 60 * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
+        x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR) * np.exp(-t / 0.18)
+        x += band_noise(len(t), rng, 80, 600) * np.exp(-t / 0.03) * 0.25
+        return x * 0.8
+    t = np.arange(int(0.25 * SR)) / SR
+    x = band_noise(len(t), rng, 900, 5000) * np.exp(-t / 0.025) * 0.55
+    x += np.sin(2 * np.pi * 420 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.04) * 0.35
+    return x
+
+
+def shaker(rng, accent=1.0):
+    t = np.arange(int(0.12 * SR)) / SR
+    e = np.minimum(1, t / 0.008) * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
+    return band_noise(len(t), rng, 4000, 12000) * e * 0.12 * accent
+
+
+def ping(m, rng):
+    t = np.arange(int(3.0 * SR)) / SR
+    f = float(mtof(m))
+    return (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) + 0.2 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * 2.003 * t)) * np.exp(-t / 0.8) * np.minimum(1, t / 0.003) * 0.3
+
+
+# --- effects -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def fftconv(x, ir):
+    n_ = len(x) + len(ir) - 1
+    size = 1 << (n_ - 1).bit_length()
+    return np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(x, size) * np.fft.rfft(ir, size), size)[: len(x)]
+
+
+def reverb(send, rng, seconds=6.0, predelay=0.03, dark=6000.0):
+    """A stereo hall: decaying noise impulse responses (darker as they decay)."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(send)
+    n_ = int(seconds * SR)
+    t = np.arange(n_) / SR
+    for ch in range(2):
+        ir = rng.standard_normal(n_) * np.exp(-t * 6.9 / seconds)
+        # darken over time: blend a low-passed copy in
+        lp = band_noise(n_, rng, 20, dark * 0.25) * np.exp(-t * 6.9 / seconds)
+        mixw = np.clip(t / (seconds * 0.5), 0, 1)
+        ir = ir * (1 - mixw) * 0.6 + lp * mixw * 0.9
+        ir[: int(predelay * SR)] = 0
+        ir /= np.sqrt(np.sum(ir ** 2)) + 1e-9
+        out[ch] = fftconv(send[ch], ir)
+    return out
+
+
+def pingpong(x, delay_s, fb=0.45, taps=7):
+    out = np.zeros_like(x)
+    d = int(delay_s * SR)
+    mono = (x[0] + x[1]) * 0.5
+    for k in range(1, taps + 1):
+        sh = d * k
+        if sh >= x.shape[1]:
+            break
+        ch = k % 2
+        out[ch, sh:] += mono[: x.shape[1] - sh] * fb ** k
+    return out
+
+
+def sweep_lowpass(x, fc_fn, frame=4096, hop=1024):
+    """A low-pass whose cutoff follows fc_fn(t seconds) - STFT, overlap-add."""
+    win = np.hanning(frame)
+    fr = np.fft.rfftfreq(frame, 1 / SR)
+    out = np.zeros_like(x)
+    norm = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
+    for s in range(0, x.shape[1] - frame, hop):
+        fc = fc_fn((s + frame / 2) / SR)
+        g = 1 / (1 + (fr / fc) ** 4)
+        for ch in range(2):
+            seg = x[ch, s:s + frame] * win
+            out[ch, s:s + frame] += np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(seg) * g, frame) * win
+        norm[s:s + frame] += win ** 2
+    return out / np.maximum(norm, 1e-6)
+
+
+def compress(x, thresh_db=-20, ratio=2.0, win_s=0.08):
+    mono = np.sqrt((x[0] ** 2 + x[1] ** 2) / 2)
+    w = int(win_s * SR)
+    c = np.cumsum(np.concatenate([[0], mono ** 2]))
+    rms = np.sqrt(np.maximum((c[w:] - c[:-w]) / w, 1e-12))
+    rms = np.concatenate([np.full(w - 1, rms[0]), rms])
+    lvl = 20 * np.log10(rms + 1e-9)
+    over = np.maximum(lvl - thresh_db, 0)
+    gdb = -over * (1 - 1 / ratio)
+    # smooth the gain (attack/release ~ 0.3 s)
+    k = int(0.3 * SR)
+    g = np.convolve(10 ** (gdb / 20), np.ones(k) / k, mode="same")
+    return x * g
+
+
+def master(mix, rng, delay_s, rev_s=6.0, target_db=-17.0):
+    if np.any(mix.pad):
+        mix.dry += mix.pad_filtered
+    wet = reverb(mix.send, rng, rev_s)
+    dl = pingpong(mix.delay, delay_s)
+    wet += reverb(dl * 0.5, rng, rev_s * 0.6) * 0.5
+    x = mix.dry + wet * 0.75 + dl
+    # seamless loop: the tail past the loop's end back onto the start
+    L = int(LOOP * SR)
+    x[:, : x.shape[1] - L] += x[:, L:]
+    x = x[:, :L]
+    x -= x.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
+    x = compress(x)
+    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2))
+    x *= 10 ** (target_db / 20) / (rms + 1e-9)
+    ceil = 10 ** (-1 / 20)
+    x = np.tanh(x / ceil) * ceil
+    return x
+
+
+# --- the tracks ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def track_menu():
+    """'Atrapos' - 72 BPM, 36 bars of D minor: Dm9 - Bbmaj9 - Gm9 - Asus4, three bars each."""
+    m = Mix(72, 101)
+    rng = m.rng
+    chords = [["D3", "F3", "A3", "C4", "E4"], ["Bb2", "D3", "F3", "A3", "C4"],
+              ["G2", "Bb2", "D3", "F3", "A3"], ["A2", "D3", "E3", "G3", "B3"]]
+    roots = ["D2", "Bb1", "G1", "A1"]
+    bar = m.beat * 4
+    for c in range(12):                                    # 12 chords x 3 bars = 36 bars
+        ch = chords[c % 4]
+        t0 = m.at(c * 3)
+        for i, note in enumerate(ch):
+            m.add(pad_note(n(note), bar * 3, rng, a=2.5, r=3.0), t0, pan=-0.6 + 1.2 * i / (len(ch) - 1), rev=0.5, bus="pad")
+        m.add(sub(n(roots[c % 4]), bar * 3 - 0.2, a=1.0, r=1.5), t0, rev=0.05, gain=0.35)
+        # the arpeggio: 16ths up through the chord, bars 6..30 (fading in and out)
+        for b in range(3):
+            barno = c * 3 + b
+            level = np.clip((barno - 5) / 2, 0, 1) * np.clip((31 - barno) / 4, 0, 1)
+            if level <= 0:
+                continue
+            seq = [n(x) + 12 for x in ch] + [n(ch[1]) + 24, n(ch[2]) + 24]
+            for s in range(16):
+                note = seq[[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 4, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 3][s]]
+                acc = 1.0 if s % 4 == 0 else 0.7
+                m.add(pluck(note, rng, decay=0.5, bright=0.6), m.at(barno, s * 0.25),
+                      pan=0.35 * np.sin(s * 0.7), rev=0.25, delay=0.35, gain=0.65 * level * acc)
+    # the bells: a slow melody, bars 12..30
+    melody = [(12, 0, "A4", 3), (12, 3, "C5", 1), (13, 0, "D5", 6), (14, 2, "F5", 2), (15, 0, "E5", 4),
+              (16, 0, "D5", 3), (16, 3, "C5", 1), (17, 0, "A4", 8),
+              (19, 0, "F5", 2), (19, 2, "E5", 2), (20, 0, "D5", 4), (21, 0, "C5", 2), (21, 2, "D5", 2), (22, 0, "E5", 8),
+              (24, 0, "A4", 3), (24, 3, "C5", 1), (25, 0, "D5", 4), (26, 0, "F5", 2), (26, 2, "G5", 2),
+              (27, 0, "A5", 6), (28, 2, "G5", 2), (29, 0, "F5", 4), (30, 0, "E5", 3), (30, 3, "D5", 1), (31, 0, "D5", 8)]
+    for barno, beat, note, ln in melody:
+        m.add(bell(n(note), rng, decay=2.2 + ln * 0.25), m.at(barno, beat), pan=0.15, rev=0.6, delay=0.25, gain=0.95)
+    # air: soft wind, slowly breathing (24 s - five times a loop)
+    tt = np.arange(m.N) / SR
+    wind = band_noise(m.N, rng, 400, 4500) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * tt / 24.0)) * 0.035
+    m.add(wind, 0.0, pan=0.0, rev=0.4)
+    m.pad_filtered = sweep_lowpass(m.pad, lambda t: 2400 + 1300 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 24.0 - 1.5))
+    return master(m, rng, delay_s=m.beat * 0.75)
+
+
+def track_space():
+    """'Deep Drift' - 60 BPM, 30 bars of C minor: six chords, five bars each."""
+    m = Mix(60, 202)
+    rng = m.rng
+    chords = [["C3", "G3", "D4", "Eb4"], ["Ab2", "Eb3", "G3", "D4"], ["Eb3", "Bb3", "D4", "G4"],
+              ["Bb2", "F3", "C4", "D4"], ["F2", "C3", "Ab3", "G4"], ["G2", "D3", "C4", "F4"]]
+    bar = m.beat * 4
+    for c in range(6):
+        t0 = m.at(c * 5)
+        for i, note in enumerate(chords[c]):
+            m.add(pad_note(n(note), bar * 5, rng, voices=6, detune=0.18, bright=0.6, a=5.0, r=5.0),
+                  t0, pan=-0.7 + 1.4 * i / 3, rev=0.7, bus="pad")
+    tt = np.arange(m.N) / SR
+    # the drone: C1 and G1, breathing
+    drone = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * float(mtof(n("C1"))) * tt) + 0.6 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * float(mtof(n("G1"))) * tt)
+             + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * float(mtof(n("C2"))) * 1.002 * tt))
+    m.add(drone * (0.75 + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * tt / 40.0)) * 0.055, 0.0, rev=0.2)
+    # a slow pulse: a soft low C every two beats
+    for k in range(int(LOOP / (m.beat * 2))):
+        m.add(sub(n("C2"), 0.6, a=0.08, r=1.2), k * m.beat * 2, rev=0.3, gain=0.17 * (0.8 + 0.2 * (k % 2 == 0)))
+    # twinkles: high bells from the chords, here and there
+    for c in range(6):
+        notes = [n(x) + 24 for x in chords[c]]
+        for k in range(7):
+            t0 = m.at(c * 5) + rng.uniform(0, bar * 5 - 1)
+            m.add(bell(int(rng.choice(notes)), rng, decay=3.5, ratio=2.76, index=1.2), t0,
+                  pan=rng.uniform(-0.9, 0.9), rev=0.85, gain=0.45)
+    # sonar: a ping every 8 s, echoing away
+    for k in range(15):
+        m.add(ping(n("G5") if k % 2 == 0 else n("D5"), rng), k * 8.0 + 2.0, pan=-0.3 if k % 2 else 0.3, rev=0.6, delay=0.5, gain=0.55)
+    # swells: filtered noise rising and falling every 20 s
+    sw = band_noise(m.N, rng, 200, 3000)
+    ph = (tt % 20.0) / 20.0
+    m.add(sw * np.sin(np.pi * ph) ** 3 * 0.05, 0.0, rev=0.8)
+    m.pad_filtered = sweep_lowpass(m.pad, lambda t: 1600 + 700 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 40.0))
+    return master(m, rng, delay_s=m.beat * 1.5, rev_s=8.0)
+
+
+def track_surface():
+    """'Minoan Shores' - 96 BPM, 48 bars: Am - G - F - E (two bars each), six times."""
+    m = Mix(96, 303)
+    rng = m.rng
+    chords = [["A2", "E3", "A3", "C4"], ["G2", "D3", "G3", "B3"], ["F2", "C3", "F3", "A3"], ["E2", "B2", "E3", "G#3"]]
+    roots = ["A1", "G1", "F1", "E1"]
+    arps = [["A3", "C4", "E4", "A4"], ["G3", "B3", "D4", "G4"], ["F3", "A3", "C4", "F4"], ["E3", "G#3", "B3", "E4"]]
+    bar = m.beat * 4
+    for c in range(24):                                    # 24 chords x 2 bars = 48 bars
+        ch = c % 4
+        t0 = m.at(c * 2)
+        for i, note in enumerate(chords[ch]):
+            m.add(pad_note(n(note), bar * 2, rng, voices=3, detune=0.08, bright=0.5, a=1.2, r=1.8, shape="tri"),
+                  t0, pan=-0.5 + i / 3, rev=0.35, bus="pad", gain=1.3)
+        for b in range(2):
+            barno = c * 2 + b
+            # bass: the root on 1 and the "and" of 2
+            for beat in (0.0, 1.5, 2.5):
+                m.add(pluck(n(roots[ch]), rng, decay=0.9, bright=0.35), m.at(barno, beat), rev=0.1, gain=0.45)
+            # the lyre: 8ths through the chord, bars 4..44
+            level = np.clip((barno - 3) / 2, 0, 1) * np.clip((45 - barno) / 3, 0, 1)
+            if level > 0:
+                pat = [0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3] if b == 0 else [3, 2, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 1]
+                for s, idx in enumerate(pat):
+                    m.add(pluck(n(arps[ch][idx]) + 12, rng, decay=1.1, bright=0.8), m.at(barno, s * 0.5),
+                          pan=0.4 if s % 2 else -0.2, rev=0.3, delay=0.15, gain=0.65 * level * (1.0 if s % 2 == 0 else 0.75))
+            # frame drum (dum . tek . . dum tek .) and a shaker, bars 8..40
+            dl = np.clip((barno - 7) / 2, 0, 1) * np.clip((41 - barno) / 3, 0, 1)
+            if dl > 0:
+                for s, k in enumerate(["dum", None, "tek", None, None, "dum", "tek", None]):
+                    if k:
+                        m.add(drum(k, rng), m.at(barno, s * 0.5), pan=-0.1 if k == "dum" else 0.25, rev=0.25, gain=0.7 * dl)
+                for s in range(16):
+                    m.add(shaker(rng, 1.0 if s % 4 == 2 else 0.55), m.at(barno, s * 0.25), pan=0.5, rev=0.15, gain=dl)
+    # the flute: a phrase in E Phrygian dominant (the E chord's G#), bars 16..40
+    phrase = [(0, 0, "E5", 1), (0, 1, "F5", 1), (0, 2, "G#5", 2), (1, 0, "A5", 3), (1, 3, "G#5", 1),
+              (2, 0, "F5", 2), (2, 2, "E5", 2), (3, 0, "E5", 4),
+              (4, 0, "C6", 2), (4, 2, "B5", 1), (4, 3, "A5", 1), (5, 0, "B5", 4), (6, 0, "A5", 1), (6, 1, "G#5", 1),
+              (6, 2, "F5", 2), (7, 0, "E5", 4)]
+    for start in (16, 24, 32):
+        for barno, beat, note, ln in phrase:
+            m.add(flute(n(note) - (12 if start == 24 else 0), ln * m.beat, rng), m.at(start + barno, beat),
+                  pan=-0.15, rev=0.45, delay=0.2, gain=1.1)
+    # the sea: noise in slow waves (every 10 s)
+    tt = np.arange(m.N) / SR
+    sea = band_noise(m.N, rng, 150, 1800) * (0.35 + 0.65 * np.sin(np.pi * ((tt % 10.0) / 10.0)) ** 2) * 0.04
+    m.add(sea, 0.0, pan=0.0, rev=0.3)
+    m.pad_filtered = sweep_lowpass(m.pad, lambda t: 2600 + 800 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 30.0))
+    return master(m, rng, delay_s=m.beat * 0.75)
+
+
+TRACKS = {"menu": ("Atrapos", track_menu), "space": ("Deep Drift", track_space), "surface": ("Minoan Shores", track_surface)}
+
+
+# --- output, analysis -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def write_ogg(x, path):
+    pcm = (np.clip(x.T, -1, 1) * 32767).astype("<i2")
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as fh:
+        tmp = fh.name
+    with wave.open(tmp, "wb") as w:
+        w.setnchannels(2)
+        w.setsampwidth(2)
+        w.setframerate(SR)
+        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
+    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", tmp, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "4", path], check=True)
+    os.remove(tmp)
+
+
+def analyse(x):
+    db = lambda v: 20 * np.log10(max(float(v), 1e-9))
+    mono = x.mean(axis=0)
+    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2))
+    # the loop seam: the jump across it, against the typical sample-to-sample step
+    step = np.median(np.abs(np.diff(mono[:SR])))
+    seam = abs(mono[0] - mono[-1])
+    # level over time (1 s windows): steady for a menu / background loop?
+    w = SR
+    lv = [db(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[i:i + w] ** 2))) for i in range(0, len(mono) - w, w)]
+    X = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(mono[: SR * 30]))
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(SR * 30, 1 / SR)
+    bands = {"sub <60": (0, 60), "bass 60-250": (60, 250), "low-mid 250-1k": (250, 1000), "mid 1-4k": (1000, 4000), "high 4k+": (4000, 22050)}
+    tot = np.sum(X ** 2)
+    share = {k: float(np.sum(X[(f >= a) & (f < b)] ** 2) / tot) for k, (a, b) in bands.items()}
+    corr = float(np.corrcoef(x[0], x[1])[0, 1])
+    return {"rms_db": db(rms), "peak_db": db(np.max(np.abs(x))), "seam": seam / (step + 1e-9), "lv_min": min(lv),
+            "lv_max": max(lv), "share": share, "stereo_corr": corr, "levels": lv}
+
+
+def picture(x, a, path, title):
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+    W, H = 1200, 260
+    mono = x.mean(axis=0)
+    nfft, cols = 2048, W
+    hop = (len(mono) - nfft) // cols
+    win = np.hanning(nfft)
+    S = np.array([np.abs(np.fft.rfft(mono[i * hop:i * hop + nfft] * win)) for i in range(cols)]).T
+    fr = np.fft.rfftfreq(nfft, 1 / SR)
+    rows = np.geomspace(30, 16000, H)
+    S = 20 * np.log10(S[np.clip(np.searchsorted(fr, rows), 0, len(fr) - 1)] + 1e-6)
+    S = np.clip((S - (S.max() - 75)) / 75, 0, 1)[::-1]
+    rgb = np.stack([np.clip(S * 2 - 0.5, 0, 1), np.clip(S * 1.5 - 0.2, 0, 1) ** 1.2, np.clip(S * 1.2, 0, 1) ** 0.6], -1)
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (W + 20, H + 120), (12, 10, 18))
+    img.paste(Image.fromarray((rgb * 255).astype(np.uint8)), (10, 30))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    d.text((10, 8), "%s  -  %d s loop  ·  RMS %.1f dBFS  ·  peak %.1f  ·  seam jump %.1fx a normal step" % (title, LOOP, a["rms_db"], a["peak_db"], a["seam"]), fill=(235, 220, 190))
+    lv = a["levels"]   # level curve under it
+    y0 = H + 40
+    for i in range(len(lv) - 1):
+        x0, x1 = 10 + i * W / len(lv), 10 + (i + 1) * W / len(lv)
+        d.line([(x0, y0 + 70 - (lv[i] + 40) * 2), (x1, y0 + 70 - (lv[i + 1] + 40) * 2)], fill=(120, 220, 255), width=2)
+    d.text((10, y0 + 72), "level per second (dBFS, -40 .. -5)", fill=(150, 160, 180))
+    img.save(path)
+
+
+def main():
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+    os.makedirs(REPORT, exist_ok=True)
+    which = sys.argv[1:] or list(TRACKS)
+    lines = ["# The music - analysis", "", "tools/music_gen.py: stereo 44.1 kHz, Vorbis q4, each a seamless %d s loop." % LOOP,
+             "seam = the jump across the loop point in units of a typical sample step (~1 = seamless);",
+             "corr = left/right correlation (1 = mono, lower = wider).", "",
+             "| track | RMS dBFS | peak | level range (1 s) | seam | corr | sub | bass | low-mid | mid | high | size |",
+             "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
+    for key in which:
+        title, fn = TRACKS[key]
+        print("rendering", key, "...", flush=True)
+        x = fn()
+        path = os.path.join(OUT, key + ".ogg")
+        write_ogg(x, path)
+        a = analyse(x)
+        picture(x, a, os.path.join(REPORT, key + ".png"), '%s - "%s"' % (key, title))
+        s = a["share"]
+        lines.append("| %s \"%s\" | %.1f | %.1f | %.1f .. %.1f | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f | %d KB |" % (
+            key, title, a["rms_db"], a["peak_db"], a["lv_min"], a["lv_max"], a["seam"], a["stereo_corr"],
+            s["sub <60"], s["bass 60-250"], s["low-mid 250-1k"], s["mid 1-4k"], s["high 4k+"], os.path.getsize(path) // 1024))
+        print(lines[-1], flush=True)
+    if set(which) == set(TRACKS):
+        with open(os.path.join(REPORT, "analysis.md"), "w") as fh:
+            fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -1,0 +1,490 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""The pirate's sound effects, synthesised from scratch (numpy only) - the
+game had no audio. Each sound is built from simple pieces - oscillators with
+pitch sweeps, filtered noise, inharmonic metal partials, a formant "voice"
+(a buzz through vowel resonances, ring-modulated and bit-crushed: a robot) -
+then faded in/out (no clicks), normalised and written as OGG Vorbis.
+
+  python3 tools/sfx_pirate.py            -> sounds/pirate/*.ogg (several takes of each)
+                                            external/sfx/pirate_analysis.md (a table)
+                                            external/sfx/pirate_spectrograms.png
+
+Takes: <name>_<n>.ogg; Sfx (scripts/sfx.gd) plays a random one, with a little
+random pitch, so repeats don't sound the same. Every take is seeded: the same
+files every run.
+
+The sounds (an evil android pirate with a laser rifle, a tattered coat):
+  shot      the red laser rifle: a falling zap, a crack, a thump      (4 takes)
+  raise     the rifle coming up: a servo whir up and a click           (2)
+  lower     the rifle going down: a servo whir down and a clunk        (2)
+  step      a metal foot: a dull thud and a short clank                (6)
+  hurt      hit: a sizzle and a robotic grunt                          (4)
+  death     power failing: a falling whine, sparks, a crash            (2)
+  taunt     a robot pirate's growled babble, ending in a rolled "arr"  (4)
+  flee      an alarm chirp and a quick, higher babble                  (2)
+  bolt_hit  a red bolt striking: a sizzle and a snap                   (3)
+  loot_drop the loot chest landing: a wooden thud, coins               (1)
+  loot_take picking the loot up: coins and a rising chime              (1)
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import wave
+
+import numpy as np
+
+SR = 44100
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "sounds", "pirate")
+REPORT = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "sfx")
+
+
+# --- building blocks ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def t_axis(dur):
+    return np.arange(int(dur * SR)) / SR
+
+
+def env_exp(t, attack, decay):
+    """A fast attack (s) and an exponential decay (time constant, s)."""
+    a = np.clip(t / max(attack, 1e-4), 0, 1)
+    return a * np.exp(-np.maximum(t - attack, 0) / decay)
+
+
+def phase_of(freq):
+    """Phase (radians) of an oscillator whose frequency follows the array freq."""
+    return 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(freq) / SR
+
+
+def saw(ph):
+    return 2 * ((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) - 1
+
+
+def square(ph, duty=0.5):
+    return np.where(((ph / (2 * np.pi)) % 1.0) < duty, 1.0, -1.0)
+
+
+def noise(n, rng):
+    return rng.standard_normal(n)
+
+
+def fft_filter(x, lo=None, hi=None, slope=1.0):
+    """Band-limit x to lo..hi Hz (smooth edges) in the frequency domain."""
+    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x), 1 / SR)
+    g = np.ones_like(f)
+    if lo:
+        g *= 1 / (1 + (lo / np.maximum(f, 1)) ** (2 * slope))
+    if hi:
+        g *= 1 / (1 + (f / hi) ** (2 * slope))
+    return np.fft.irfft(X * g, len(x))
+
+
+def biquad_bp(x, f0, q, gain=1.0):
+    """A resonant band-pass (RBJ cookbook), f0 may be an array (a moving resonance)."""
+    f0 = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(f0, float), x.shape)
+    y = np.zeros_like(x)
+    x1 = x2 = y1 = y2 = 0.0
+    for i in range(len(x)):
+        w = 2 * np.pi * f0[i] / SR
+        alpha = np.sin(w) / (2 * q)
+        cw = np.cos(w)
+        a0 = 1 + alpha
+        b0, b2 = alpha / a0, -alpha / a0
+        a1, a2 = -2 * cw / a0, (1 - alpha) / a0
+        yi = b0 * x[i] + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2
+        x2, x1 = x1, x[i]
+        y2, y1 = y1, yi
+        y[i] = yi
+    return y * gain
+
+
+def metal(t, rng, partials=5, lo=600, hi=4000, decay=(0.04, 0.14), amp=1.0):
+    """A clank: inharmonic partials, each decaying at its own rate."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for _ in range(partials):
+        f = rng.uniform(lo, hi)
+        out += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 6.28)) * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(*decay)) * rng.uniform(0.4, 1.0)
+    return out * amp / partials
+
+
+def thud(t, f=80, decay=0.05, rng=None):
+    """A dull low hit: a falling sine and a little low noise."""
+    ph = phase_of(f * (1 + 1.5 * np.exp(-t / 0.01)))
+    x = np.sin(ph) * np.exp(-t / decay)
+    if rng is not None:
+        x += fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=400) * np.exp(-t / (decay * 0.6)) * 0.6
+    return x
+
+
+def crackle(t, rng, rate=120, dur_each=0.002, amp=1.0):
+    """Electric crackle: random little clicks of filtered noise."""
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    n = int(rate * t[-1]) if len(t) else 0
+    for _ in range(n):
+        i = rng.integers(0, len(t))
+        L = int(dur_each * SR * rng.uniform(0.5, 2))
+        seg = rng.standard_normal(min(L, len(t) - i)) * rng.uniform(0.3, 1.0)
+        out[i:i + len(seg)] += seg * np.exp(-np.arange(len(seg)) / max(L / 3, 1))
+    return fft_filter(out, lo=1500) * amp
+
+
+def place(dst, src, at):
+    i = int(at * SR)
+    n = min(len(src), len(dst) - i)
+    if n > 0:
+        dst[i:i + n] += src[:n]
+    return dst
+
+
+def echo(x, delay=0.07, fb=0.3, taps=3):
+    out = x.copy()
+    d = int(delay * SR)
+    for k in range(1, taps + 1):
+        if d * k < len(x):
+            out[d * k:] += x[:len(x) - d * k] * (fb ** k)
+    return out
+
+
+def robot(x, rng, ring=55.0, crush=0.0):
+    """The android: ring modulation (a metallic voice) and optional bit-crushing."""
+    t = np.arange(len(x)) / SR
+    y = x * (0.55 + 0.45 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ring * t))
+    if crush:
+        steps = 2 ** (16 - crush * 12)
+        y = np.round(y * steps) / steps
+        hold = int(1 + crush * 3)          # (sample-rate reduction too)
+        y = np.repeat(y[::hold], hold)[:len(x)]
+    return y
+
+
+VOWELS = {   # F1, F2, F3 (Hz) - a deep, gruff voice
+    "a": (700, 1150, 2500), "o": (500, 850, 2400), "u": (380, 800, 2300), "e": (500, 1700, 2500),
+    "r": (480, 1150, 1500),   # (a low F3: the growled "r")
+}
+
+
+def voice(dur, pitch, vowels, rng, growl=0.0, breath=0.08):
+    """A buzz (a glottal-ish pulse train at `pitch`, an array or a number) through
+    three formant resonances moving through `vowels` (a list of letters)."""
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    p = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(pitch, float), t.shape).copy()
+    if growl:   # a rough, rolled throat: fast irregular pitch flutter
+        p *= 1 + growl * (0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 28 * t) + 0.5 * fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=15, hi=60) * 3)
+    ph = phase_of(p)
+    src = saw(ph) * 0.7 + square(ph, 0.18) * 0.3
+    src += noise(len(t), rng) * breath
+    # formants moving from vowel to vowel
+    k = np.linspace(0, len(vowels) - 1, len(t))
+    i0 = np.floor(k).astype(int)
+    i1 = np.minimum(i0 + 1, len(vowels) - 1)
+    fr = k - i0
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for j, (q, g) in enumerate(((5, 1.0), (7, 0.6), (9, 0.35))):
+        fa = np.array([VOWELS[v][j] for v in vowels])
+        f = fa[i0] * (1 - fr) + fa[i1] * fr
+        out += biquad_bp(src, f, q, g)
+    return out / (np.max(np.abs(out)) + 1e-9)     # (resonators leave it quiet: back to full scale)
+
+
+def fade(x, a=0.003, b=0.02):
+    """Fade in / out so no take starts or ends with a click."""
+    n = len(x)
+    na, nb = int(a * SR), int(b * SR)
+    if na:
+        x[:na] *= np.linspace(0, 1, na)
+    if nb:
+        x[n - nb:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, nb)
+    return x
+
+
+def finish(x, peak_db=-1.0):
+    x = x - np.mean(x)
+    x = np.tanh(x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9) * 1.2)      # (a gentle saturation: denser, no hard clips)
+    x = fade(x)
+    return x / (np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-9) * 10 ** (peak_db / 20)
+
+
+# --- the sounds ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def shot(rng):
+    dur = 0.42
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    top = rng.uniform(2000, 2800)
+    f = top * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(0.03, 0.045)) + rng.uniform(150, 220)
+    f *= 1 + 0.03 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(40, 70) * t)      # (a wobble in the beam)
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    beam = (saw(ph) * 0.6 + square(ph, 0.3) * 0.4) * env_exp(t, 0.002, 0.09)
+    beam = fft_filter(beam, lo=120, hi=9000)
+    crack = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=2000, hi=9000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.012) * 1.2
+    sub = thud(t, 65, 0.06) * 0.8
+    x = beam + crack + sub
+    return echo(x, 0.06, 0.22, 3), -1.5
+
+
+def servo(dur, f0, f1, rng):
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    f = f0 + (f1 - f0) * (t / dur) ** 0.7
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    x = saw(ph) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 32 * t))     # (gear teeth: a fast flutter)
+    x = fft_filter(x, lo=250, hi=3000)
+    return x * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(t / dur, 0, 1)) ** 0.6
+
+
+def raise_(rng):
+    dur = 0.55
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = servo(0.38, rng.uniform(130, 150), rng.uniform(250, 290), rng) * 1.6
+    x = np.pad(x, (0, len(t) - len(x)))
+    click = fft_filter(noise(int(0.008 * SR), rng), lo=2500) * np.exp(-np.arange(int(0.008 * SR)) / 60)
+    place(x, click * 0.9, 0.38)
+    tc = t_axis(0.16)
+    place(x, metal(tc, rng, 4, 1500, 4500, (0.02, 0.06), 0.6), 0.38)
+    return x, -4.0
+
+
+def lower(rng):
+    dur = 0.7
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = servo(0.48, rng.uniform(250, 280), rng.uniform(110, 130), rng) * 0.5
+    x = np.pad(x, (0, len(t) - len(x)))
+    tc = t_axis(0.22)
+    place(x, thud(tc, 95, 0.05, rng) * 0.7 + metal(tc, rng, 4, 700, 2500, (0.03, 0.09), 0.6), 0.48)
+    return x, -5.0
+
+
+def step(rng):
+    dur = 0.22
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = thud(t, rng.uniform(60, 90), rng.uniform(0.03, 0.05), rng) * 0.9
+    x += metal(t, rng, 5, 500, 3200, (0.015, 0.05), 0.45)
+    grit = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=800, hi=5000) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.015) * 0.25   # (gravel)
+    return x + grit, -9.0
+
+
+def hurt(rng):
+    dur = 0.55
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    sizzle = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=1200, hi=9000) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.07) * 0.6
+    sizzle += crackle(t, rng, 160, amp=0.5) * np.exp(-t / 0.12)
+    p = rng.uniform(95, 120) * (1 - 0.35 * (t / dur))        # (the grunt falls)
+    v = voice(dur, p, ["a", "u", "u"], rng, growl=0.06)
+    v = robot(v, rng, ring=rng.uniform(45, 70), crush=0.25)
+    v *= env_exp(t, 0.02, 0.18)
+    x = place(sizzle * 0.45, v * 1.0, 0.03)
+    return x, -2.0
+
+
+def death(rng):
+    dur = 1.9
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    f = 520 * np.exp(-t / 0.45) + 35
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    whine = (saw(ph) * 0.5 + np.sin(ph * 2) * 0.3) * np.clip(1.3 - t / 1.4, 0, 1)
+    whine = np.tanh(whine * (1 + 3 * t))                     # (more and more broken)
+    whine = fft_filter(whine, lo=40, hi=6000)
+    sparks = crackle(t, rng, 90, amp=0.7) * np.clip(1.2 - t / 1.6, 0, 1)
+    v = voice(0.7, 110 * np.exp(-t_axis(0.7) / 0.5), ["a", "o", "u"], rng, growl=0.12)
+    v = robot(v, rng, ring=40, crush=0.4) * env_exp(t_axis(0.7), 0.02, 0.3)
+    x = whine * 0.6 + sparks
+    place(x, v * 0.7, 0.02)
+    tc = t_axis(0.6)
+    place(x, thud(tc, 70, 0.09, rng) * 1.0 + metal(tc, rng, 7, 300, 2800, (0.06, 0.25), 0.9), 1.15)   # (the crash)
+    place(x, metal(t_axis(0.3), rng, 4, 900, 3500, (0.03, 0.1), 0.4), 1.33)                         # (a bounce)
+    return echo(x, 0.09, 0.2, 2), -1.0
+
+
+SYLL = [["a", "r"], ["o", "a"], ["u", "a"], ["e", "o"], ["a", "u"], ["o", "r"], ["a", "e"]]
+
+
+def babble(rng, syllables, base, spread, growl_end=True, crush=0.3, ring=None):
+    parts = []
+    for k in range(syllables):
+        d = rng.uniform(0.11, 0.2)
+        tt = t_axis(d)
+        p = base * rng.uniform(1 - spread, 1 + spread) * (1 + 0.15 * np.sin(np.pi * tt / d))   # (each syllable rises and falls)
+        v = voice(d, p, SYLL[rng.integers(len(SYLL))], rng, growl=0.03)
+        v *= np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(tt / d, 0, 1)) ** 0.5
+        cons = fft_filter(noise(int(0.025 * SR), rng), lo=2500, hi=8000) * 0.25 * np.hanning(int(0.025 * SR))
+        parts += [cons * (rng.random() < 0.6), v, np.zeros(int(rng.uniform(0.015, 0.05) * SR))]
+    if growl_end:   # "arrr": a long, rolled growl
+        d = rng.uniform(0.45, 0.6)
+        tt = t_axis(d)
+        v = voice(d, base * 0.85 * (1 - 0.15 * tt / d), ["a", "a", "r", "r", "r"], rng, growl=0.22)
+        parts.append(v * np.minimum(1, (d - tt) / 0.12) * np.minimum(1, tt / 0.02))
+    x = np.concatenate(parts)
+    return robot(x, rng, ring=ring or rng.uniform(35, 60), crush=crush)
+
+
+def taunt(rng):
+    x = babble(rng, int(rng.integers(3, 6)), rng.uniform(85, 105), 0.18)
+    return echo(x, 0.05, 0.15, 2), -2.5
+
+
+def flee(rng):
+    beeps = []
+    for k in range(2):
+        tt = t_axis(0.09)
+        f = 1400 + 900 * tt / 0.09 if k == 0 else 1900 + 900 * tt / 0.09
+        beeps.append(square(phase_of(np.full(len(tt), 1.0) * f), 0.4) * np.hanning(len(tt)) * 0.35)
+        beeps.append(np.zeros(int(0.03 * SR)))
+    x = np.concatenate(beeps + [babble(rng, 3, rng.uniform(140, 160), 0.2, growl_end=False, crush=0.2, ring=70)])
+    return x, -5.0
+
+
+def bolt_hit(rng):
+    dur = 0.32
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    snap = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=1500, hi=10000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.02)
+    f = 1800 * np.exp(-t / 0.02) + 300
+    zap = square(phase_of(f), 0.35) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.04) * 0.4
+    fizz = crackle(t, rng, 220, amp=0.6) * np.exp(-t / 0.08)
+    return snap + zap + fizz, -3.0
+
+
+def coins(t_len, rng, n=7, start=0.0):
+    x = np.zeros(int(t_len * SR))
+    at = start
+    for k in range(n):
+        tt = t_axis(0.25)
+        ting = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) * np.exp(-tt / rng.uniform(0.04, 0.1))
+                   for f in rng.uniform(3200, 7800, 3)) / 3
+        place(x, ting * rng.uniform(0.3, 0.8), at)
+        at += rng.uniform(0.02, 0.07)
+    return x
+
+
+def loot_drop(rng):
+    dur = 0.8
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    tc = t_axis(0.4)
+    wood = biquad_bp(noise(len(tc), rng), 190, 4) * env_exp(tc, 0.001, 0.05) * 1.2 + thud(tc, 85, 0.05) * 0.8
+    x = np.zeros_like(t)
+    place(x, wood, 0.0)
+    x += coins(dur, rng, 8, 0.03)
+    return x, -3.0
+
+
+def loot_take(rng):
+    dur = 0.9
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    x = coins(dur, rng, 6, 0.0) * 0.8
+    for k, f in enumerate((880, 1109, 1319, 1760)):            # (a rising arpeggio)
+        tt = t_axis(0.35)
+        ch = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * f * tt)) * env_exp(tt, 0.003, 0.12) * 0.45
+        place(x, ch, 0.06 + k * 0.07)
+    return x, -4.0
+
+
+SOUNDS = [("shot", shot, 4), ("raise", raise_, 2), ("lower", lower, 2), ("step", step, 6), ("hurt", hurt, 4),
+          ("death", death, 2), ("taunt", taunt, 4), ("flee", flee, 2), ("bolt_hit", bolt_hit, 3),
+          ("loot_drop", loot_drop, 1), ("loot_take", loot_take, 1)]
+
+
+# --- writing and analysing ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def write_ogg(x, path):
+    pcm = (np.clip(x, -1, 1) * 32767).astype("<i2")
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as fh:
+        tmp = fh.name
+    with wave.open(tmp, "wb") as w:
+        w.setnchannels(1)
+        w.setsampwidth(2)
+        w.setframerate(SR)
+        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
+    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", tmp, "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "5", path], check=True)
+    os.remove(tmp)
+
+
+def analyse(x):
+    db = lambda v: 20 * np.log10(max(v, 1e-9))
+    peak = np.max(np.abs(x))
+    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2))
+    # loudness over the loudest 100 ms (what the ear judges a short effect by)
+    w = int(0.1 * SR)
+    win = np.sqrt(np.convolve(x ** 2, np.ones(w) / w, mode="valid")) if len(x) > w else np.array([rms])
+    X = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x))
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x), 1 / SR)
+    centroid = float(np.sum(f * X) / (np.sum(X) + 1e-9))
+    lowshare = float(np.sum(X[f < 250] ** 2) / (np.sum(X ** 2) + 1e-9))
+    return {"dur": len(x) / SR, "peak_db": db(peak), "rms_db": db(rms), "loud100_db": db(np.max(win)),
+            "crest_db": db(peak) - db(rms), "centroid_hz": centroid, "low_share": lowshare,
+            "dc": float(np.mean(x)), "edge": float(max(abs(x[0]), abs(x[-1])))}
+
+
+def spectrogram(x, w=360, h=120):
+    n = 1024
+    hop = max(1, (len(x) - n) // w)
+    cols = []
+    win = np.hanning(n)
+    for i in range(w):
+        seg = x[i * hop:i * hop + n]
+        if len(seg) < n:
+            seg = np.pad(seg, (0, n - len(seg)))
+        cols.append(np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg * win)))
+    S = np.array(cols).T                                         # (freq x time)
+    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1 / SR)
+    rows = np.geomspace(40, 16000, h)                            # (log frequency, low at the bottom)
+    idx = np.clip(np.searchsorted(f, rows), 0, len(f) - 1)
+    S = 20 * np.log10(S[idx] + 1e-6)
+    S = np.clip((S - (S.max() - 70)) / 70, 0, 1)[::-1]
+    return S
+
+
+def sheet(takes, path):
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+    W, H, cols = 360, 120, 4
+    rows = (len(takes) + cols - 1) // cols
+    img = Image.new("RGB", (cols * (W + 10) + 10, rows * (H + 34) + 10), (14, 12, 20))
+    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
+    for i, (name, x) in enumerate(takes):
+        S = spectrogram(x, W, H)
+        rgb = np.stack([np.clip(S * 2.2 - 0.6, 0, 1), np.clip(S * 1.6 - 0.15, 0, 1) ** 1.3, np.clip(S * 1.3, 0, 1) ** 0.6], -1)
+        tile = Image.fromarray((rgb * 255).astype(np.uint8))
+        cx, cy = 10 + (i % cols) * (W + 10), 10 + (i // cols) * (H + 34)
+        img.paste(tile, (cx, cy + 20))
+        d.text((cx, cy + 4), "%s  (%.2f s)" % (name, len(x) / SR), fill=(235, 220, 190))
+    img.save(path)
+
+
+def main():
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+    os.makedirs(REPORT, exist_ok=True)
+    for f in os.listdir(OUT):
+        if f.endswith(".ogg"):
+            os.remove(os.path.join(OUT, f))
+    rows, takes, index = [], [], {}
+    for name, fn, n in SOUNDS:
+        index[name] = n
+        for k in range(1, n + 1):
+            rng = np.random.default_rng(sum(map(ord, name)) * 1000 + k)   # (seeded: the same takes every run)
+            x, gain_db = fn(rng)
+            x = finish(np.asarray(x, float), gain_db)
+            write_ogg(x, os.path.join(OUT, "%s_%d.ogg" % (name, k)))
+            a = analyse(x)
+            rows.append(("%s_%d" % (name, k), a))
+            if k == 1:
+                takes.append(("%s_%d" % (name, k), x))
+    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "takes.json"), "w") as fh:
+        json.dump(index, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
+    lines = ["# The pirate's sound effects - analysis", "",
+             "Generated by tools/sfx_pirate.py (mono, 44.1 kHz, OGG Vorbis q5). loud100 = the loudest 100 ms (RMS);",
+             "crest = peak over RMS (punchy > 15 dB); centroid = spectral centre of mass (brightness); low = share of energy",
+             "under 250 Hz; edge = the first / last sample (0 = no click).", "",
+             "| take | s | peak dBFS | loud100 dBFS | crest dB | centroid Hz | low | edge |",
+             "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
+    for n, a in rows:
+        lines.append("| %s | %.2f | %.1f | %.1f | %.1f | %d | %.2f | %.4f |" % (n, a["dur"], a["peak_db"], a["loud100_db"], a["crest_db"],
+                                                                         a["centroid_hz"], a["low_share"], a["edge"]))
+    with open(os.path.join(REPORT, "pirate_analysis.md"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+    sheet(takes, os.path.join(REPORT, "pirate_spectrograms.png"))
+    total = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(OUT, f)) for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.endswith(".ogg"))
+    print("%d takes, %.0f KB in %s" % (len(rows), total / 1024, OUT))
+    print("\n".join(lines[7:]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

files.explanation: New: the space sounds - weapons, hits, explosions (and ship explosions by size), engines and hums as seamless loops, docking, jumps, the scanner - 74 takes.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,440 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Sound effects for space: the ships (yours and the others), their weapons,
+hits and explosions, the stations and jump gates - synthesised from scratch
+(numpy), with the building blocks of tools/sfx_pirate.py.
+
+  python3 tools/sfx_space.py   -> sounds/space/*.ogg (takes <name>_<n>.ogg)
+                                  external/sfx/space_analysis.md, space_spectrograms.png
+
+One-shots (Sfx plays a random take, pitch varied a little):
+  laser x4          your laser: a quick bright pew
+  plasma x3         the plasma cannon: a fat, wobbling blast with a low thump
+  missile x3        a missile launch: a clunk, a hiss and a rising whoosh
+  enemy_laser x4    other ships' lasers: thinner, more nasal
+  hit_shield x4     a hit on your shields: a ringing energy "tchong"
+  hit_hull x4       a hit on your hull: a metal clang and crunch
+  spark x4          a laser bolt striking another ship: a short crackle
+  boom_small x3     a missile / plasma impact: a crisp, short explosion
+  boom_big x3       a ship exploding: a deep rumbling blast and debris
+  ship_boom_small x3   a fighter / interceptor blowing up: a sharp crack, a fireball whoomp,
+                       debris pinging away, a short rumble
+  ship_boom_medium x3  a gunship / freighter: a heavier blast, two secondary pops, more debris
+  ship_boom_large x2   a frigate or bigger (bosses too): a deep detonation, a chain of secondary
+                       blasts, the hull groaning apart, a long rumbling tail
+  ship_boom_player x1  your own ship: the reactor whining up, a huge blast, a ringing in your ears
+  scan_laser x2     the scanner sweeping an asteroid: a buzzing laser warble, data chirps
+  scan_pulse x2     a system scan: a deep sonar-like energy pulse rippling outwards, three times
+  scan_done x1      a scan complete: two bright rising blips
+  shields_down x1   an alarm: two falling tones, twice
+  afterburner x2    a roaring kick, sweeping up
+  shield_boost x2   a rising charge and a shimmering hum
+  repair x2         ratchets and a welding buzz, then a chime
+  rock_break x3     an asteroid shattering: a stony crunch and pebbles
+  pickup x3         an item picked up: a soft blip up
+  credits x3        credits: bright coin chimes
+  dock x1           docking: thrusters easing, clamps, a pressure hiss
+  undock x1         undocking: a release hiss, clamps letting go, thrust up
+  jump x2           a jump: charging up, then a swooping warp
+  land x1           descending into the atmosphere: a rushing roar down
+  take_off x1       climbing out: a roar up, fading into space
+  select x2         a weapon selected: a short double tick
+Loops (seamless; played continuously, faded by the game):
+  engine_loop       your engine: a low hum and soft rumble (louder / higher with thrust)
+  mining_loop       the mining beam: a buzzing, crackling laser
+  station_hum       a station: a deep machinery hum with a slow throb and distant clanks
+  gate_hum          a jump gate: an eerie chord shimmering in and out
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import sfx_pirate as P   # (the building blocks and the writer)

+def laser(rng):
+    t = t_axis(0.2)
+    f = rng.uniform(1900, 2400) * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(0.025, 0.035)) + rng.uniform(380, 480)
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    x = (square(ph, 0.25) * 0.6 + np.sin(ph) * 0.4) * env_exp(t, 0.001, 0.05)
+    x += fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=3000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.006) * 0.3
+    return echo(fft_filter(x, lo=200, hi=9000), 0.045, 0.18, 2), -8.0
+
+
+def plasma(rng):
+    t = t_axis(0.55)
+    f = rng.uniform(600, 750) * np.exp(-t / 0.09) + rng.uniform(70, 90)
+    f *= 1 + 0.08 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(25, 35) * t)        # (the wobble)
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    x = (saw(ph) * 0.5 + square(ph, 0.5) * 0.5) * env_exp(t, 0.003, 0.14)
+    x = fft_filter(x, lo=50, hi=4000)
+    x += thud(t, 55, 0.08) * 0.9
+    x += fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=500, hi=4000) * env_exp(t, 0.002, 0.05) * 0.35
+    return echo(x, 0.07, 0.25, 3), -4.0
+

+def missile(rng):
+    t = t_axis(1.0)
+    x = np.zeros_like(t)
+    place(x, metal(t_axis(0.15), rng, 4, 400, 1800, (0.02, 0.06), 0.9) + thud(t_axis(0.15), 90, 0.03) * 0.7, 0.0)
+    hiss = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=1500, hi=8000) * env_exp(t - 0.05, 0.03, 0.25) * (t > 0.05) * 0.5
+    whoosh_f = 300 + 1500 * np.clip((t - 0.08) / 0.8, 0, 1) ** 0.6
+    whoosh = biquad_bp(noise(len(t), rng), whoosh_f, 3) * np.clip((t - 0.06) / 0.1, 0, 1) * np.exp(-np.maximum(t - 0.2, 0) / 0.35)
+    return x + hiss + whoosh * 0.6, -5.0

+def enemy_laser(rng):

+def hit_shield(rng):
+    t = t_axis(0.6)
+    out = np.zeros_like(t)
+    for f in rng.uniform([600, 900, 1350], [700, 1050, 1600]):
+        out += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t * (1 + 0.04 * np.exp(-t / 0.05))) * np.exp(-t / rng.uniform(0.12, 0.2))
+    out = out / 3 * (1 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 18 * t))                  # (a shimmer)
+    zap = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=2500, hi=9000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.02) * 0.6

+def boom(rng, size):
+    dur = 0.8 if size == "small" else 2.6
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    dec = 0.12 if size == "small" else 0.6
+    body = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=1500 if size == "small" else 700) * env_exp(t, 0.002, dec)
+    crack = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=1500, hi=9000) * env_exp(t, 0.0005, 0.02 if size == "small" else 0.05)
+    low = thud(t, 50 if size == "small" else 38, 0.12 if size == "small" else 0.45) * (0.8 if size == "small" else 1.3)
+    x = body + crack * 0.6 + low
+    if size == "big":
+        # rumble with random swells, and debris clanks scattered after
+        rumble = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=200) * env_exp(t, 0.05, 1.0) * 1.2
+        x += rumble
+        for k in range(6):
+            place(x, metal(t_axis(0.3), rng, 4, 600, 3000, (0.03, 0.1), 0.25), rng.uniform(0.2, 1.4))
+        x += crackle(t, rng, 60, amp=0.35) * np.exp(-t / 0.8)
+    return echo(x, 0.09, 0.25, 3), (-3.0 if size == "small" else -1.0)

+def _blast(rng, dur, body_hi, body_dec, thump_f, thump_dec, crack_dec, amp=1.0):
+    """One explosion: a crack, a fireball (bright then dark), a falling thump."""
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    bright = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=300, hi=body_hi) * env_exp(t, 0.002, body_dec * 0.35)
+    dark = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=body_hi * 0.35) * env_exp(t, 0.008, body_dec)
+    crack = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=2000, hi=10000) * env_exp(t, 0.0004, crack_dec)
+    snap = metal(t, rng, 4, 2500, 6500, (0.004, 0.015), 1.0)
+    low = thud(t, thump_f, thump_dec, rng)
+    return (bright * 0.7 + dark * 0.9 + crack * 0.55 + snap * 0.5 + low * 1.3) * amp
+

+def ship_boom(rng, size):
+    cfg = {  # dur, body hi, body decay, thump f, thump decay, crack decay, secondaries, debris, tail
+        "small": (1.8, 2600, 0.22, rng.uniform(52, 62), 0.16, 0.025, 0, 4, 0.5),
+        "medium": (2.8, 2000, 0.35, rng.uniform(42, 50), 0.28, 0.035, 2, 7, 0.9),
+        "large": (4.6, 1500, 0.6, rng.uniform(32, 38), 0.5, 0.05, 5, 11, 1.6),
+        "player": (4.4, 1600, 0.55, 34, 0.5, 0.05, 3, 9, 1.4),
+    }[size]
+    dur, hi, dec, f, tdec, cdec, n_sec, n_debris, tail = cfg
+    x = np.zeros(int(dur * SR))
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    at = 0.0
+    if size == "player":   # the reactor whining up to the breaking point
+        w = t_axis(0.5)
+        ph = phase_of(420 + 1500 * (w / 0.5) ** 2)
+        whine = (np.sin(ph) * 0.6 + saw(ph) * 0.15) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 22 * w)) * (w / 0.5) ** 1.5
+        place(x, fft_filter(whine, lo=300, hi=6000) * 0.35, 0.0)
+        at = 0.48
+    place(x, _blast(rng, dur - at, hi, dec, f, tdec, cdec), at)
+    # Secondary blasts: smaller, higher, scattered after the first.
+    for k in range(n_sec):
+        when = at + rng.uniform(0.18, 0.35 + dur * 0.45) * (1 + k * 0.15)
+        if when < dur - 0.4:
+            place(x, _blast(rng, 0.9, hi * 1.3, dec * 0.4, f * rng.uniform(1.3, 1.8), tdec * 0.45, cdec * 0.8,
+                            amp=rng.uniform(0.35, 0.65)), when)
+    # The hull groaning apart (big ships).
+    if size in ("large", "player"):
+        g = t_axis(1.6)
+        ph = phase_of(rng.uniform(85, 100) * np.exp(-g / 1.4))
+        groan = saw(ph) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 7 * g)) * env_exp(g, 0.25, 0.8)
+        place(x, fft_filter(groan, lo=60, hi=900) * 0.3, at + 0.5)
+    # Debris pinging away, burning crackle, a rumbling tail.
+    for k in range(n_debris):
+        place(x, metal(t_axis(0.35), rng, 4, 700, 4200, (0.02, 0.09), rng.uniform(0.12, 0.3)), at + rng.uniform(0.15, dur * 0.7))
+    x += crackle(t, rng, 50 + 15 * n_sec, amp=0.3) * np.exp(-t / (dur * 0.35)) * (t > at)
+    x += fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), hi=180) * env_exp(np.maximum(t - at, 0), 0.06, tail) * (t > at) * 1.1
+    if size == "player":   # a ringing in your ears, fading
+        x += np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3600 * t) * 0.04 * env_exp(np.maximum(t - at, 0), 0.3, 1.2) * (t > at)
+    return echo(x, 0.11, 0.22, 3), -1.0

+def scan_laser(rng):

+def repair(rng):

+def jump(rng):
+    t = t_axis(2.4)
+    f = 80 + 900 * np.clip(t / 1.4, 0, 1) ** 2

+def make_loop(fn, dur, rng):
+    """fn(t, rng) over dur + 1 s, the last second crossfaded into the first: seamless."""
+    t = t_axis(dur + 1.0)
+    x = fn(t, rng)
+    n, k = int(dur * SR), SR
+    w = np.linspace(0, 1, k)
+    head = x[:k] * w + x[n:n + k] * (1 - w)
+    return np.concatenate([head, x[k:n]])
+
+
+def engine_loop(rng):
+    def fn(t, rng):
+        hum = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) * a for f, a in ((55, 1.0), (110, 0.5), (165.5, 0.25), (220.3, 0.12)))
+        hum *= 1 + 0.08 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 7 * t)
+        rumble = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=40, hi=400) * 0.6
+        air = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=800, hi=3000) * 0.12
+        return hum * 0.5 + rumble + air
+    return make_loop(fn, 4.0, rng), -10.0
+
+
+def mining_loop(rng):
+    def fn(t, rng):
+        buzz = saw(phase_of(np.full(len(t), 120.0) * (1 + 0.01 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3 * t))))
+        buzz = biquad_bp(buzz, 900, 1.5) + fft_filter(buzz, lo=100, hi=3000) * 0.3
+        return buzz * 0.6 + crackle(t, rng, 70, amp=0.5) + fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=3000, hi=8000) * 0.08
+    return make_loop(fn, 3.0, rng), -3.0
+
+
+def station_hum(rng):
+    def fn(t, rng):
+        hum = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) * a for f, a in ((48, 1.0), (96, 0.6), (144.2, 0.3), (240.5, 0.12)))
+        hum *= 0.75 + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 2.0)              # (a slow throb, 2 s - divides the loop)
+        air = fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=150, hi=1200) * 0.25
+        x = hum * 0.6 + air
+        for k in range(5):
+            place(x, metal(t_axis(0.4), rng, 4, 300, 1500, (0.05, 0.2), 0.35), rng.uniform(0.5, 7.0))
+        return x
+    return make_loop(fn, 8.0, rng), -12.0
+
+
+def gate_hum(rng):
+    def fn(t, rng):
+        x = np.zeros_like(t)
+        for f, ph in ((110, 0), (164.8, 1.3), (220.5, 2.1), (329.6, 0.7), (440.9, 2.9)):
+            x += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + 0.6 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.25 * t + ph)) * (0.6 + 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 4.0 + ph))
+        return x / 5 + fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=2000, hi=8000) * 0.05 * (1 + np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 4.0))
+    return make_loop(fn, 8.0, rng), -12.0

+    os.makedirs(REPORT, exist_ok=True)
+    for f in os.listdir(OUT):
+        if f.endswith(".ogg"):
+            os.remove(os.path.join(OUT, f))
+    rows, takes = [], []
+    for name, fn, n in SOUNDS:
+        for k in range(1, n + 1):
+            rng = np.random.default_rng(sum(map(ord, name)) * 1000 + k + 7)
+            x, gain_db = fn(rng)
+            x = np.asarray(x, float)
+            if name in LOOPS:   # (no fades: they must join up; just level them)
+                x = x - x.mean()

+            else:

+            a = P.analyse(x)
+            if name in LOOPS:
+                a["edge"] = abs(x[0] - x[-1])   # (for a loop: the jump across the seam)
+            rows.append(("%s_%d" % (name, k), a))

+             "| take | s | peak dBFS | loud100 dBFS | crest dB | centroid Hz | low | edge |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
+    for nme, a in rows:
+        lines.append("| %s | %.2f | %.1f | %.1f | %.1f | %d | %.2f | %.4f |" % (nme, a["dur"], a["peak_db"], a["loud100_db"], a["crest_db"],
+                                                                         a["centroid_hz"], a["low_share"], a["edge"]))
+    with open(os.path.join(REPORT, "space_analysis.md"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+    P.sheet(takes, os.path.join(REPORT, "space_spectrograms.png"))
+    total = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(OUT, f)) for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.endswith(".ogg"))
+    print("%d takes, %.0f KB in %s" % (len(rows), total / 1024, OUT))

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

@@ -1,0 +1,143 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Sound effects on the planets' surfaces - synthesised from scratch (numpy),
+with the building blocks of tools/sfx_pirate.py.
+  python3 tools/sfx_surface.py  -> sounds/surface/*.ogg (takes <name>_<n>.ogg)
+                                   external/sfx/surface_analysis.md, surface_spectrograms.png
+  door_open x3    a sliding door opening: a pneumatic release hiss, the panels
+                  whirring apart on their motor, a soft stop as they reach the wall
+  door_close x3   closing: the motor whirring them shut, a firm clunk as they
+                  meet, the seal hissing tight
+Each lasts about as long as the door takes to move (SlidingDoor.SPEED).
+  chest_open x2   a wooden chest: the latch clicks, the lid creaks up on its hinges
+  locker_open x2  a metal locker: a latch snaps, the thin door squeaks and rattles
+  vault_open x2   a vault: the wheel ratchets round, the bolts clunk back, the seal hisses
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import sfx_pirate as P
+from sfx_pirate import SR, t_axis, env_exp, phase_of, saw, noise, fft_filter, metal, thud, place
+
+ROOT = P.ROOT
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "sounds", "surface")
+REPORT = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "sfx")
+
+
+def motor(dur, f0, f1, rng):
+    """The door's motor: a whirring saw with gear flutter, swelling and fading."""
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    f = f0 + (f1 - f0) * (t / dur) ** 0.8
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    x = saw(ph) * (0.65 + 0.35 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(38, 46) * t))
+    x = fft_filter(x, lo=160, hi=2600)
+    return x * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(t / dur, 0, 1)) ** 0.7
+
+
+def hiss(dur, lo, hi, attack, decay, rng):
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    return fft_filter(noise(len(t), rng), lo=lo, hi=hi) * env_exp(t, attack, decay)
+
+
+def door_open(rng):
+    x = np.zeros(int(0.5 * SR))
+    place(x, hiss(0.25, 1500, 6000, 0.002, 0.05, rng) * 0.28, 0.0)            # the seal lets go
+    place(x, motor(0.32, rng.uniform(170, 200), rng.uniform(400, 460), rng) * 0.8, 0.03)
+    t = t_axis(0.12)
+    place(x, thud(t, f=rng.uniform(95, 115), decay=0.03, rng=rng) * 0.35, 0.33)   # a soft stop in the wall
+    place(x, metal(t, rng, partials=3, lo=900, hi=2600, decay=(0.02, 0.05), amp=0.12), 0.33)
+    return x, -9.0
+
+
+def door_close(rng):
+    x = np.zeros(int(0.55 * SR))
+    place(x, motor(0.3, rng.uniform(420, 460), rng.uniform(160, 190), rng) * 0.8, 0.0)
+    t = t_axis(0.16)
+    place(x, thud(t, f=rng.uniform(75, 90), decay=0.05, rng=rng) * 0.9, 0.29)     # the panels meet
+    place(x, metal(t, rng, partials=4, lo=500, hi=2200, decay=(0.03, 0.08), amp=0.3), 0.29)
+    place(x, hiss(0.18, 2000, 6500, 0.01, 0.04, rng) * 0.2, 0.31)                  # sealing tight
+    return x, -9.0
+
+
+def creak(dur, f0, f1, rng, rough=0.5):
+    """A hinge creak: a scraping, stuttering tone."""
+    t = t_axis(dur)
+    f = f0 + (f1 - f0) * (t / dur) + rng.uniform(5, 20) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(6, 11) * t)
+    ph = phase_of(f)
+    x = saw(ph) * (1 - rough + rough * (np.sin(2 * np.pi * rng.uniform(28, 45) * t) > 0.2))   # stick-slip
+    x = fft_filter(x, lo=400, hi=3800)
+    return x * np.sin(np.pi * np.clip(t / dur, 0, 1)) ** 0.8
+
+
+def click(rng, f=2600, amp=1.0):
+    t = t_axis(0.03)
+    return metal(t, rng, partials=3, lo=f * 0.6, hi=f * 1.6, decay=(0.004, 0.012), amp=amp)
+
+
+def chest_open(rng):
+    x = np.zeros(int(0.7 * SR))
+    place(x, click(rng, 1800, 0.8), 0.0)                                   # the latch
+    place(x, click(rng, 1400, 0.5), 0.05)
+    place(x, creak(0.45, rng.uniform(260, 320), rng.uniform(420, 520), rng) * 0.55, 0.1)
+    t = t_axis(0.12)
+    place(x, thud(t, f=rng.uniform(130, 160), decay=0.025, rng=rng) * 0.4, 0.55)   # the lid at rest
+    return x, -9.0
+
+
+def locker_open(rng):
+    x = np.zeros(int(0.6 * SR))
+    place(x, click(rng, 3200, 1.0), 0.0)
+    place(x, creak(0.3, rng.uniform(700, 800), rng.uniform(950, 1100), rng, rough=0.7) * 0.4, 0.06)
+    t = t_axis(0.25)
+    place(x, metal(t, rng, partials=6, lo=700, hi=3500, decay=(0.04, 0.12), amp=0.45), 0.34)   # the door's thin rattle
+    return x, -10.0
+
+
+def vault_open(rng):
+    x = np.zeros(int(1.2 * SR))
+    for k in range(7):                                                     # the wheel's ratchet
+        place(x, click(rng, rng.uniform(2000, 2400), 0.7), 0.04 + k * 0.075)
+    t = t_axis(0.2)
+    place(x, thud(t, f=rng.uniform(60, 75), decay=0.07, rng=rng) * 1.0, 0.6)       # the bolts drawn back
+    place(x, metal(t, rng, partials=5, lo=300, hi=1500, decay=(0.05, 0.15), amp=0.35), 0.6)
+    place(x, hiss(0.4, 1200, 6000, 0.01, 0.12, rng) * 0.3, 0.65)
+    place(x, motor(0.35, 120, 90, rng) * 0.35, 0.78)                      # the heavy door swinging
+    return x, -8.0
+
+
+SOUNDS = [("door_open", door_open, 3), ("door_close", door_close, 3), ("chest_open", chest_open, 2),
+          ("locker_open", locker_open, 2), ("vault_open", vault_open, 2)]
+
+
+def main():
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+    os.makedirs(REPORT, exist_ok=True)
+    for f in os.listdir(OUT):
+        if f.endswith(".ogg"):
+            os.remove(os.path.join(OUT, f))
+    rows, takes = [], []
+    for name, fn, n in SOUNDS:
+        for k in range(1, n + 1):
+            rng = np.random.default_rng(sum(map(ord, name)) * 1000 + k + 11)
+            x, gain_db = fn(rng)
+            x = P.finish(np.asarray(x, float), gain_db)
+            P.write_ogg(x, os.path.join(OUT, "%s_%d.ogg" % (name, k)))
+            rows.append(("%s_%d" % (name, k), P.analyse(x)))
+            if k == 1:
+                takes.append(("%s_%d" % (name, k), x))
+    lines = ["# Surface sound effects - analysis", "",
+             "Generated by tools/sfx_surface.py (mono, 44.1 kHz, OGG Vorbis q5). Columns as in pirate_analysis.md.", "",
+             "| take | s | peak dBFS | loud100 dBFS | crest dB | centroid Hz | low |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
+    for nme, a in rows:
+        lines.append("| %s | %.2f | %.1f | %.1f | %.1f | %d | %.2f |" % (nme, a["dur"], a["peak_db"], a["loud100_db"], a["crest_db"],
+                                                                   a["centroid_hz"], a["low_share"]))
+    with open(os.path.join(REPORT, "surface_analysis.md"), "w") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+    P.sheet(takes, os.path.join(REPORT, "surface_spectrograms.png"))
+    total = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(OUT, f)) for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.endswith(".ogg"))
+    print("%d takes, %.0f KB in %s" % (len(rows), total / 1024, OUT))
+    print("\n".join(lines[5:]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -1,0 +1,161 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Spoken dialogue: every story line recorded with Piper (neural text to
+speech, offline), one voice per character.
+
+    ~/.local/share/space-atrapos-tts/venv/bin/python tools/voice_lines.py [--force] [--only <speaker>]
+
+Setup (once; outside the project, not in builds):
+    uv venv -p 3.12 ~/.local/share/space-atrapos-tts/venv
+    uv pip install -p ~/.local/share/space-atrapos-tts/venv/bin/python piper-tts==1.8.0 onnxruntime==1.31.0
+    the voice models (VOICES below) in ~/.local/share/space-atrapos-tts/models/
+      from https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices (each with its MODEL_CARD)
+
+The lines: the main quest's dialogue (data/main_quest.json - every stage's
+lines, Kilon Alios's offer / replies, his "where it leads now" for every
+objective) plus EXTRA. Each becomes voices/lines/<key>.ogg, key = the first
+16 hex digits of sha1("<speaker>|<text without BBCode, trimmed>") - the game
+(scripts/voice.gd) works the same key out from the line it shows, so a line
+plays only its own recording. Edit a line and it falls silent until this is
+run again (lines already recorded are skipped; recordings no line uses any
+more are deleted). Each voice is recorded, then given its colour with ffmpeg
+(pitch, a metallic edge, a radio band) and levelled to -18 LUFS.
+
+Writes external/voices/lines.md (every line, its voice, length) and
+external/voices/CREDITS.md (the voices' licences).
+"""
+import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile, wave
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "voices", "lines")
+REPORT = os.path.join(ROOT, "external", "voices")
+MODELS = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/space-atrapos-tts/models")
+
+# Voices: the model, how fast (length scale: >1 slower), and the colour
+# (an ffmpeg filter chain; "" = as recorded). Licences: commercial use allowed.
+PITCH = "asetrate=22050*{k},aresample=22050,atempo={t}"
+VOICES = {
+    "kilon":    {"model": "en_US-norman-medium", "length": 1.08,
+                 "fx": PITCH.format(k=0.86, t=round(1 / 0.86, 4)) + ",aecho=0.8:0.5:7|13:0.22|0.12,highpass=f=70"},
+    "ariadne":  {"model": "en_GB-cori-high", "length": 1.0, "fx": ""},
+    "daidalos": {"model": "en_GB-northern_english_male-medium", "length": 1.05, "fx": ""},
+    "asterion": {"model": "en_US-joe-medium", "length": 1.08,
+                 "fx": PITCH.format(k=0.8, t=1.25) + ",aecho=0.7:0.4:35:0.18,lowpass=f=6500"},
+    "narrator": {"model": "en_GB-alba-medium", "length": 1.08, "fx": ""},
+    "radio":    {"model": "en_US-norman-medium", "length": 0.98,
+                 "fx": "highpass=f=380,lowpass=f=3200,acompressor=threshold=0.1:ratio=6:attack=5:release=60,volume=1.6"},
+}
+SPEAKERS = {"Kilon Alios": "kilon", "Dr. Ariadne Kephala": "ariadne", "Nikos Daidalos": "daidalos",
+            "Asterion": "asterion", "Narrator": "narrator", "Kepler Outpost": "radio"}
+# Lines spoken outside the quest file (speaker, text).
+EXTRA = [("Kilon Alios", "The thread is in your hands.")]   # the Voices volume slider's sample
+# How some names are said (the text shown is unchanged).
+SAY = {"Kephala": "Kefala", "Daidalos": "Dye-dah-los", "Phaistos": "Fysstos", "Knossos": "Nossos",
+       "Ka-no-so": "Kah, no, so", "labrys": "lab-ris", "Keftiu": "Keftyoo", "Thera": "Theera",
+       "Asterion": "Asteerion", "Kilon Alios": "Keelon Aleeos", "Moirai": "Moyray"}
+
+BB = re.compile(r"\[[^\]]*\]")
+
+
+def plain(text):
+    return BB.sub("", text).strip()
+
+
+def key(speaker, text):
+    return hashlib.sha1(("%s|%s" % (speaker, plain(text))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def voice_for(speaker):
+    if speaker in SPEAKERS:
+        return SPEAKERS[speaker]
+    for w in ["Station", "Outpost", "Dock", "Relay"]:
+        if w in speaker:
+            return "radio"
+    return None
+
+
+def spoken(text):
+    t = plain(text)
+    for a, b in SAY.items():
+        t = t.replace(a, b)
+    return t.replace(" - ", ", ")
+
+
+def lines():
+    d = json.load(open(os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "main_quest.json")))
+    out = []
+    for st in d["stages"]:
+        out += [tuple(l) for l in st.get("dialogue", [])]
+    g = d.get("giver", {})
+    for k in ["offer", "accepted", "declined", "later", "done"]:
+        out += [tuple(l) for l in g.get(k, [])]
+    name = g.get("name", "Kilon Alios")
+    for st in d["stages"]:   # his "where it leads now" (planet_surface.gd talk_to_quest_giver)
+        out.append((name, "Where it leads now: [b]%s[/b]." % st["objective"]))
+    out += EXTRA
+    seen, uniq = set(), []
+    for sp, tx in out:
+        if (sp, tx) not in seen and voice_for(sp):
+            seen.add((sp, tx))
+            uniq.append((sp, tx))
+    return uniq
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--only")
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    from piper import PiperVoice, SynthesisConfig
+    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+    os.makedirs(REPORT, exist_ok=True)
+    todo = lines()
+    loaded = {}
+    rows = []
+    keep = set()
+    for sp, tx in todo:
+        vid = voice_for(sp)
+        k = key(sp, tx)
+        keep.add(k)
+        path = os.path.join(OUT, k + ".ogg")
+        if (a.force or not os.path.exists(path)) and (not a.only or a.only == sp):
+            v = VOICES[vid]
+            if v["model"] not in loaded:
+                loaded[v["model"]] = PiperVoice.load(os.path.join(MODELS, v["model"] + ".onnx"))
+            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+                raw = os.path.join(tmp, "raw.wav")
+                with wave.open(raw, "wb") as w:
+                    loaded[v["model"]].synthesize_wav(spoken(tx), w, syn_config=SynthesisConfig(length_scale=v["length"]))
+                chain = (v["fx"] + "," if v["fx"] else "") + "loudnorm=I=-18:LRA=7:TP=-2,aresample=22050"
+                subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", raw, "-af", chain, "-ac", "1",
+                                "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "4", path], check=True)
+            print("recorded", vid, k, plain(tx)[:60])
+        dur = float(subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", path],
+                                   capture_output=True, text=True).stdout or 0)
+        rows.append("| %s | %s | %.1f s | %s |" % (vid, k, dur, plain(tx).replace("|", "/")))
+    removed = 0
+    for f in os.listdir(OUT):
+        if f.endswith(".ogg") and f[:-4] not in keep:
+            os.remove(os.path.join(OUT, f))
+            imp = os.path.join(OUT, f + ".import")
+            if os.path.exists(imp):
+                os.remove(imp)
+            removed += 1
+    size = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(OUT, f)) for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.endswith(".ogg"))
+    with open(os.path.join(REPORT, "lines.md"), "w") as f:
+        f.write("# Spoken lines\n\nMade by tools/voice_lines.py (Piper). %d lines, %.1f MB.\n\n| voice | file | length | line |\n|---|---|---|---|\n"
+                % (len(rows), size / 1e6) + "\n".join(rows) + "\n")
+    with open(os.path.join(REPORT, "CREDITS.md"), "w") as f:
+        f.write("# Voice credits\n\nSpoken dialogue made with Piper (https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl) and these voices "
+                "(https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices):\n\n")
+        for vid, v in VOICES.items():
+            card = os.path.join(MODELS, v["model"] + ".MODEL_CARD")
+            lic = ""
+            if os.path.exists(card):
+                m = re.search(r"License:\s*(.*)", open(card).read())
+                lic = m.group(1).strip() if m else ""
+            f.write("- %s: %s - %s\n" % (vid, v["model"], lic))
+    print("%d lines, %.1f MB, %d old recordings removed" % (len(rows), size / 1e6, removed))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
